raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## What

Moves 24 tests out of the always-on AMD PR stages and into the AMD extra workflow (`pr-test-amd-extra.yml`, `run-ci` + `run-ci-extra`). They are the tests CUDA already keeps in its extra tier: the `basic_perf` throughput/latency/API tests, `test_torch_compile`, LoRA eviction/drainer/logprob-diff, the RL weight-update tests, `test_vlm_models` / `test_generation_models`, and the 4-GPU `test_pp_single_node_extra` / `test_lora_gpt_oss_20b_logprob_diff`.

## Why

On recent PR runs that reached the GPU stages, PR Test (AMD) took a median of about 4.3 h from start to the last job, against about 1.6 h for PR Test on CUDA. These 24 files account for about 125 min of AMD runner time per PR run, measured from the per-file `elapsed=` lines in job logs. The largest are `test_serving_throughput` (19 min), `test_pp_throughput` (12 min) and `test_torch_compile` (7.5 min).

## Notes for the reviewer

- A new suite, `extra-b-test-4-gpu-amd`, and its job take the two 4-GPU files, with the same container env as `stage-c-test-4-gpu-amd`.
- The extra-a jobs are now sharded 2 / 3 / 2. The existing comment argued for a single shard when the suite was ~4 min; with these files, 1-gpu-large is ~1.5 h.
- `pr-test-amd.yml` shards:
  - 1-gpu-small: 14 → 12, so 3 waves at `max-parallel: 4` instead of 4.
  - 1-gpu-large: 3 → 2.
  - 2-gpu-large: 2 → 1.
  - The `wait-for-stage-b-amd` counts are updated to match.
- ~~Scheduled `pr-test-amd.yml` runs still chain the extra workflow through `call-pr-test-amd-extra`, so main keeps this coverage twice a day.~~ **Correction:** that scheduled call was being skipped, because the skipped label gate on scheduled runs also skipped the jobs after it. So from this merge (Oct 24) until #47244 (Oct 29) these tests ran only on PRs labeled `run-ci-extra`, not on main. #47244 fixed the call, and scheduled runs now run the AMD extra suites.

Related: #46085 (large-model tests to nightly), #46086 (parallel shards). The three PRs are independent and merge cleanly in any order.

## Test plan

- [ ] `pr-test-amd-extra.yml` dispatch (all extra jobs, rocm10): pending
- [ ] `pr-test-amd.yml` dispatch of `stage-b-test-1-gpu-large-amd`, `stage-b-test-2-gpu-large-amd`, `stage-c-test-4-gpu-amd` (rocm10): pending

-# Stage: extra-a. Each job mirrors the container bring-up of pr-test-amd.yml
-# and dispatches `run_suite.py --hw amd --suite extra-a-test-{config}-amd`:

-#                  kv_canary self-bench)
-#   - 2-gpu-large: multi-GPU (TP/PP/PD) mock-model + kv_canary e2e tests
+# Stages: extra-a and extra-b. Each job mirrors the container bring-up of
+# pr-test-amd.yml and dispatches `run_suite.py --hw amd --suite
+# {stage}-test-{config}-amd`:
+#   - extra-a 1-gpu-small: mock-model / kv_canary unit + single-GPU canary e2e
+#                          tests, plus LoRA eviction/drainer, priority
+#                          scheduling, torch-native attention
+#   - extra-a 1-gpu-large: single-GPU model e2e tests (quant fp8kv-triton,
+#                          sessions, spec standalone triton, basic_perf
+#                          throughput/latency, torch.compile, VLM models)
+#   - extra-a 2-gpu-large: multi-GPU (TP/PP/PD) mock-model + kv_canary e2e
+#                          tests, PP/MoE throughput, distributed weight update
+#   - extra-b 4-gpu:       PP extra configs, gpt-oss-20b LoRA logprob diff
+# Everything here is in CUDA's extra tier too.
 # kv_canary e2e is registered to the same extra-a stage as its CUDA siblings
 # (it now exercises the ROCm canary kernels end-to-end).
 
@@ -125,15 +131,15 @@ jobs:

   # =============================================== extra-a (1-gpu-small) ===============================================
-  # Single unpartitioned job: the 21 onboarded unit tests total ~233s, so the
-  # expensive per-job setup (container bring-up + sgl-kernel ROCm build + dep

-  # setup across scarce AMD GPUs to shave only a couple minutes of test time,

     runs-on: ${{ format('linux-{0}-1gpu-sglang', inputs.runner_arch || 'mi300') }}
     steps:

@@ -157,16 +163,20 @@ jobs:

+
+  # =============================================== extra-b (4-gpu) ===============================================
+  # 4-GPU tests that CUDA runs in extra-b. Same container env as the
+  # stage-c-test-4-gpu-amd job in pr-test-amd.yml.
+  extra-b-test-4-gpu-amd:
+    name: ${{ format('extra-b-test-4-gpu-amd ({0}, linux-{1}-4gpu-sglang)', inputs.rocm_version || 'rocm10', inputs.runner_arch || 'mi300') }}

+

   # =============================================== aggregator ====================================================
   # Single fan-in job so branch protection / notifications depend on one job
